aether_nebula_flow.name: Aether Nebula
aether_nebula_flow.author: silentoplayz (G30)
aether_nebula_flow.description: Slow nebula gas in the theme's own colors gathers at the edges and thins behind the chat, under frosted glass that keeps Open WebUI's shapes. Every mode designed, Light and Her included.

amber_command_1979.name: Amber Command: 1979
amber_command_1979.author: silentoplayz (G30)
amber_command_1979.description: An amber phosphor terminal: monospace replies with a prompt before each heading, and packets of amber light streaming along faint lanes at the sides. Light and Her print the same terminal in amber ink on warm paper.

amethyst.name: Amethyst
amethyst.author: silentoplayz (G30)
amethyst.description: Violet glass over a deep amethyst gradient in Dark, pale lilac in Light, orchid in Her. Headings, links and the input ring take the stone's violet.

apollo_analogue_futurism.name: Apollo Analogue Futurism
apollo_analogue_futurism.author: silentoplayz (G30)
apollo_analogue_futurism.description: A 1960s flight console in warm gray and cream with signal orange for focus and links, and a brass orrery turning in the lower corner. Light and Her are cream and warm beige panels with dark lettering.

ascii_big_fish.name: ASCII Big Fish Eat Little Fish
ascii_big_fish.author: silentoplayz (G30)
ascii_big_fish.description: A port of Aenvo's ASCII Big Fish Eat Little Fish: the original's character-cell fish, sharks, schools, corals and light beams, quiet behind the chat, with a Playable setting that lets your cursor steer a fish that eats, grows and can be eaten. The original's teal-to-navy water in Dark, true black on OLED, a pale lagoon in Light and sea glass in Her. MIT licensed, copyright 2026 drewdi.

astral_projection.name: Astral Projection
astral_projection.author: silentoplayz (G30)
astral_projection.description: Faint violet-blue constellations drift in the outer thirds of the screen behind frosted glass panels. Light and Her keep the same star chart, drawn in deep blue and lilac ink on pale paper.

bio_digital_synthesis.name: Bio-Digital Synthesis
bio_digital_synthesis.author: silentoplayz (G30)
bio_digital_synthesis.description: A neural net of magenta links and cyan pulses fires in the outer thirds of the screen behind frosted membrane glass. Light is pale aqua with magenta headings, Her a soft pink with teal ones.

bioluminescence.name: Bioluminescence
bioluminescence.author: silentoplayz (G30)
bioluminescence.description: Glowing cyan and violet jellyfish drift over a dark seafloor at the edges of the screen, with cyan headings and frosted panels. Light and Her are sunlit shallow water, with caustics on pale sand and teal ink.

blue_lightning.name: Blue Lightning
blue_lightning.author: silentoplayz (G30)
blue_lightning.description: Cerulean rain slants past a low skyline while pale blue lightning forks in the outer thirds of the screen, with soft flashes. Light and Her keep the storm in slate and periwinkle ink on a pale sky.

chongqing_fog_city.name: Chongqing Fog City
chongqing_fog_city.author: silentoplayz (G30)
chongqing_fog_city.description: A river city of layered neon towers drifts past in mist and mirrors onto the water, dimmed and lowered behind the chat. Amber, magenta and cyan windows over cool fog grey, dark blue-grey at night, true black on OLED, pale mist in Light and a warm lantern haze in Her.

emerald.name: Emerald
emerald.author: silentoplayz (G30)
emerald.description: Green glass over a deep emerald gradient in Dark, pale mint in Light, warmer jade in Her. Headings, links and the input ring take the stone's green.

entropy_data_storm.name: Entropy Data Storm
entropy_data_storm.author: silentoplayz (G30)
entropy_data_storm.description: A containment console in black and hazard yellow: a faint glitching grid at the edges, a yellow focus ring and sidebar edge, and uppercase monospace headings underlined in yellow. Light and Her set the same marks on concrete gray and warm cream.

four_seasons_desynced.name: Four Seasons
four_seasons_desynced.author: silentoplayz (G30)
four_seasons_desynced.description: One season in each mode: a summer night with fireflies over the grass in Dark, falling autumn leaves on warm parchment in Light, snow on a winter night in OLED, and butterflies in a spring garden in Her. Each mode has its own palette and accent.

gemstone_glow.name: Gemstone Glow
gemstone_glow.author: fubarpie
gemstone_glow.description: A Gemini inspired theme that adds a beautiful gemstone glow to the chat input window.

iridescent_liquid_glass.name: Iridescent Liquid Glass
iridescent_liquid_glass.author: silentoplayz (G30)
iridescent_liquid_glass.description: Veins of thin-film glass fold slowly at the screen's edges in teal, violet and rose, thinning behind the chat under clear frosted surfaces. Rose-violet glass at night, true black on OLED, pearl in Light and a rosier pearl in Her.

kinetic_thermal_plasma_core.name: Plasma Core
kinetic_thermal_plasma_core.author: silentoplayz (G30)
kinetic_thermal_plasma_core.description: A fusion core in the lower corner glows cool blue on a new chat and heats to orange and red as the conversation fills the context, under console glass with orange monospace headings. Light and Her show the core as colored ink on pale steel and warm sand.

koi_pond.name: Koi Pond
koi_pond.author: silentoplayz (G30)
koi_pond.description: Koi glide along the edges of a clear teal pond under lily pads and moving light, calmer behind the chat, with frosted glass over the water. Every mode is the same pond: deep teal at night, true black on OLED, and pale clear water in Light and Her.

lumina_aurora.name: Lumina Aurora
lumina_aurora.author: silentoplayz (G30)
lumina_aurora.description: Aurora ribbons in indigo, violet and blue sway across the top of the screen behind layered frosted glass with a thin highlight along its top edge. Indigo night in Dark, true black in OLED, pale lavender in Light and orchid in Her.

matrix_rain.name: Matrix Rain
matrix_rain.author: silentoplayz (G30)
matrix_rain.description: Green digital rain of mixed katakana and Latin glyphs at the sides of the screen, with monospace replies in green phosphor. Light and Her keep the green as ink on pale paper.

midsummer.name: Midsummer
midsummer.author: Claude
midsummer.description: A summer day in four modes: fireflies over the meadow at night in Dark, a sky that follows your clock over sage in Light, slow constellations on true black in OLED, and rising embers in honey and parchment at golden hour in Her.

molten_forge.name: Molten Forge
molten_forge.author: silentoplayz (G30)
molten_forge.description: Lava rivers glow through cracked crust along the screen's sides and floor with rising embers, cooling to faint cracks behind the chat. Deep orange, ember red and amber over near-black crust at night, true black on OLED, warm ash in Light and terracotta ash in Her.

neo_tactical_archive_01.name: Neo-Tactical Archive
neo_tactical_archive_01.author: silentoplayz (G30)
neo_tactical_archive_01.description: A military console in slate gray with safety orange for focus, status marks and links, over slowly flowing topographic contours at the sides. Light reads as a cool field manual, Her as desert sand.

obsidian.name: Obsidian
obsidian.author: silentoplayz (G30)
obsidian.description: Black volcanic glass with no color: neutral grays, a faint black-to-navy gradient in Dark, pure black in OLED and cool or warm paper grays in Light and Her.

parallax_vista.name: Parallax Vista
parallax_vista.author: silentoplayz (G30)
parallax_vista.description: Layered dusk mountain ranges part into a valley behind the chat, with a soft apricot sun beside it, mist in the folds and drifting fireflies. Navy and violet at night, true black on OLED, a pale lavender morning in Light and an apricot dawn in Her.

pink_hues.name: Pink Hues
pink_hues.author: silentoplayz (G30)
pink_hues.description: Soft pink and rose blobs drift slowly like out-of-focus lights behind frosted glass, thinning behind the chat. Deep rose in Dark, true black with pink accents in OLED, pale blush in Light and peach in Her.

project_singularity.name: Project Singularity
project_singularity.author: silentoplayz (G30)
project_singularity.description: A dark, slowly warping surface bends the edges of the screen like space around a black hole, leaving the chat clear under deep violet glass. Light and Her show the same distortion as faint ink on pale lavender and orchid.

rose_pine.name: Rosé Pine
rose_pine.author: silentoplayz (G30)
rose_pine.description: A port of the Rosé Pine palette: Main in Dark, Moon's accents on true black in OLED, Dawn in Light, and a rose-lit Dawn in Her. Iris, foam, pine, rose and love mark headings, links and focus.

ruby.name: Ruby
ruby.author: silentoplayz (G30)
ruby.description: Crimson glass over a deep ruby gradient in Dark, pale rose in Light, coral in Her. Headings, links and the input ring take the stone's red.

sapphire.name: Sapphire
sapphire.author: silentoplayz (G30)
sapphire.description: Blue glass over a deep sapphire gradient in Dark, pale sky in Light, periwinkle in Her. Headings, links and the input ring take the stone's blue.

solar_flare.name: Solar Flare
solar_flare.author: silentoplayz (G30)
solar_flare.description: Golden embers rise from the bottom of the screen behind warm glass edged with a gold hairline, with gold headings in replies. Amber dark in Dark, true black in OLED, champagne in Light and rose gold in Her.

sovereign.name: Sovereign
sovereign.author: silentoplayz (G30)
sovereign.description: Slow, faint stained-glass cells drift at the edges behind navy glass with crisp hairlines and spaced headings. Navy in Dark, true black in OLED, cool porcelain in Light and slate wisteria in Her.

synthwave_1984.name: Synthwave 1984
synthwave_1984.author: silentoplayz (G30)
synthwave_1984.description: A striped neon sun sets over a cyan grid at the edge of the screen, with hot pink headings and cyan links on deep purple. Light and Her are a pastel vaporwave daylight in lavender and aqua.

the_cyanotype.name: The Cyanotype
the_cyanotype.author: silentoplayz (G30)
the_cyanotype.description: A blueprint: white schematic traces grow at the sides of a Prussian blue page, with lettered headings and dashed rules. Light and Her turn it into blueprint ink on a white page and violet diazo ink on a pale one.

toxic_nebula_smog_core.name: Toxic Nebula
toxic_nebula_smog_core.author: silentoplayz (G30)
toxic_nebula_smog_core.description: Acid green and violet cell cultures grow and split in the outer thirds of the screen over violet smog, with green headings and a dashed hazard rule. Light and Her are pale lilac and orchid lab glass with deep green ink.

windows_hotdog_stand.name: Windows Hot Dog Stand
windows_hotdog_stand.author: silentoplayz (G30)
windows_hotdog_stand.description: The Windows 3.1 Hot Dog Stand colors, ketchup red, mustard yellow and black, with flat drop shadows. Dark is a deep red page with a black sidebar, Light a mustard page, Her a bun-colored page with a mustard sidebar, OLED black with red edges.
